sections: This Privacy Policy explains how Metamodern Dev, LLC ("Metamodern Dev," "we," "us," or "our") processes information when you use the BB Name mobile application (the "App"). It also explains the choices and privacy rights that may be available to you.
This Privacy Policy applies to the Baby Names mobile application on Android and iOS.
The controller responsible for the processing described in this Privacy Policy is:
Metamodern Dev, LLC
Privacy contact: metamodern.dev@gmail.com
This Privacy Policy applies to the App, related support communications, the image-delivery infrastructure used by the App, and the third-party services integrated into the App.

The App does not require an account. Most information you enter or create in the App is stored locally on your device and is not transmitted to Metamodern Dev. Separately, Google services integrated into the App process technical, analytics, diagnostic, advertising, consent, and purchase-related information as described below.

description.title3: Information stored locally on your device

list.title: The App may process and store the following information locally:
items: a surname that you choose to enter;
names you have liked, disliked, or viewed, together with related timestamps;
name filters and sorting preferences, such as gender, letters, and name length;
the selected name dataset and application language;
application state and preferences, including launch and interface counters;
purchase entitlement information needed to remember an optional one-time purchase; and
search text while you use the search function. Search text is processed for the requested search and is not intentionally sent to our servers or Firebase Analytics.

sections: We do not intentionally send the surname, the names you view, like or dislike, search terms, or filter selections to Firebase Analytics as custom events or parameters. We do not use this locally stored information to build advertising or behavioral profiles.
Device and operating-system backups

Depending on your device, operating-system version, manufacturer, and backup settings, locally stored App data may be included in a system backup or device-to-device transfer provided by the platform operator, such as Google. Metamodern Dev does not receive, access, or control these system backups. You can manage available backup settings through your device or platform account.

You can delete the App's local copy of this information by clearing the App's storage in your device settings or by uninstalling the App. A system backup, if one exists, is controlled separately by the relevant platform provider and your platform-account settings.
If you choose to share a name card, the App creates a temporary image locally. The image may contain the selected name, the surname you entered, and other information visible on the card.

The App passes the temporary image to the operating system's share interface only after you initiate sharing. You choose the receiving application or person. The temporary file is deleted by the App after the sharing operation is completed or attempted. The recipient application or service processes the shared content under its own privacy policy, and Metamodern Dev does not control that processing.

description.title5: Name images and technical server logs

sections: When you open information about a name, the App may request the corresponding image from api.metamodern.dev. If the primary request is unsuccessful, the App may use a relay hosted on metamodern.dev.

list.title: As part of an ordinary internet request, our server and infrastructure providers may receive:
items: your IP address;
the date and time of the request;
the requested image path, which may indicate the name whose image was displayed;
standard HTTP request information, such as protocol and user-agent information; and
technical error and response information.

sections1: These technical logs are used only to deliver images, maintain service availability, diagnose failures, prevent abuse, and protect infrastructure. They are not combined with the surname or locally stored choices, are not used for advertising or behavioral profiling, and are not sent to Firebase Analytics by this image-delivery process.

Technical access and error logs are retained for no longer than 30 days, after which they are deleted or irreversibly aggregated unless a longer period is necessary to investigate a specific security incident or comply with law.

list.title: Firebase Analytics is enabled in the App and automatically processes information about use of the App. Depending on the device and available settings, this may include:
items: an App Instance ID, Firebase Installation ID, advertising identifier, App Set ID, or similar identifiers;
device model, operating system, language, country or approximate location derived from technical signals, App version, and mobile-network information;
App launches, sessions, engagement, screen or feature interactions, and other automatically collected events;
advertising impressions and interactions when Analytics is linked with AdMob; and
automatically collected in-app purchase events, as described below.

sections: Firebase Analytics is used to understand aggregate App usage, maintain and improve the App, evaluate feature performance, and measure advertising and purchase activity. We do not configure custom Analytics events or parameters to transmit the surname, the names you view, like or dislike, search terms, or filter settings.

The Firebase Analytics property may be linked with AdMob and Google Play. These links allow Google services to exchange eligible analytics, advertising, attribution, audience, and purchase information in accordance with the configured Google account settings and Google's terms.

User-level and event-level Analytics data is configured for a 14-month retention period. The retention period resets when the user has new activity. This setting does not necessarily control aggregated reports or information retained by Google for security, fraud prevention, legal compliance, or other purposes described in Google's policies.

Advertising privacy choices presented through AdMob do not necessarily disable Firebase Analytics. Where permitted by law, we rely on our legitimate interests in understanding App performance and improving reliability. Different legal bases, including consent, may apply where required by applicable law.
For more information, see Google's Firebase Privacy information and Google's Privacy Policy.

list.title: Firebase Crashlytics is enabled in release versions of the App and is used to identify, diagnose, and correct crashes and stability problems. Crashlytics may process:
items: crash reports, stack traces, and diagnostic logs;
App state at the time of a crash;
device model, operating-system version, App version, and technical configuration;
Firebase Installation ID and crash-installation identifiers; and
other technical information needed to group and investigate errors.

sections: We do not configure Crashlytics custom keys or logs to include the surname entered by the user, the user's liked or disliked name selections, search terms, or filter selections.

description.title8: Firebase Remote Config and platform delivery services

sections: Firebase Remote Config is used to deliver and update non-personal configuration values, such as thresholds controlling when an App-rating prompt may appear. Remote Config may process a Firebase Installation ID and technical App or device information needed to deliver configuration values and prevent abuse. It is not used to upload the surname, name choices, search terms, or filters.

Google Play services and Play Asset Delivery may process limited device metadata, App version information, request status, and diagnostic information to deliver App components and datasets and to protect the distribution process.
The App uses Google AdMob and does not currently use another advertising network or mediation provider. The App may display banner, native, app-open, and rewarded advertisements.

list.title: AdMob and its authorized advertising partners may automatically collect or receive information such as:
items: IP address and approximate location;
advertising identifiers, App Set ID, and other device or account identifiers;
App and device information;
ad impressions, views, clicks, rewarded-ad completion, and other interactions;
diagnostic, performance, fraud-prevention, and security information; and
consent and advertising-preference signals.

sections1: Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) is used to request and store applicable advertising choices and, where required, enables users to review or change those choices.

list1.title: Our intended advertising behavior is:
items: EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland: personalized advertising is requested only where the required consent has been obtained through the applicable Google consent form. If consent is not provided, the App may request non-personalized or limited ads where available.

Applicable U.S. states: users can exercise applicable choices, including opting out of personalized or targeted advertising and activities that may be treated as a sale or sharing under state law, through the available privacy-options interface.

Brazil: AdMob does not currently provide a dedicated LGPD message equivalent to its European or U.S. state messages. Personalized advertising may be enabled by default to the extent permitted by applicable law and the configured AdMob settings. Google provides controls for personalized and non-personalized ads and uses eligible advertising technology providers for Brazilian traffic.

Other regions: personalized advertising may be enabled by default where permitted by applicable law. Additional advertising controls may be available through device settings or Google account settings.

sections2: On iOS, access to Apple's advertising identifier (IDFA) is subject to Apple's App Tracking Transparency requirements where applicable.

Even non-personalized or limited ads may use IP addresses, device information, contextual information, and limited identifiers for ad delivery, frequency capping, aggregate reporting, security, and fraud prevention.
For more information, see How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services, Google AdMob privacy information, and Google's Privacy Policy.

sections: The App may offer an optional one-time in-app purchase. Purchases are processed by the app store through which you obtained the App, such as Google Play or the Apple App Store.

The App may receive the product identifier, purchase or entitlement status, purchase token or transaction identifier, and other information required by the store SDK to activate, acknowledge, and restore the purchase. Metamodern Dev does not receive or store payment-card or bank-account details.

Because Firebase Analytics is enabled, Google may automatically record an in_app_purchase event containing information such as the product identifier and name, price or value, currency, and quantity. It does not include the surname or name-selection data entered in the App. Google Play may also process order, payment, tax, refund, account, security, and fraud-prevention information under Google's own terms and privacy policy.

If you contact us, we receive the information you choose to provide, such as your email address, message, attachments, and related technical metadata. We use it to respond, provide support, investigate problems, protect our rights, and comply with legal obligations.
Support correspondence is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary to resolve the request, maintain an appropriate support record, handle disputes, or meet legal requirements.

description.title12: How and why information is used

list.title: Depending on the information and applicable law, we and our service providers process information to:
items: provide the App and the functionality you request;
save your choices locally and generate or share name cards;
deliver name images and App assets;
process and restore an optional purchase;
display, measure, and protect advertising;
understand aggregate App usage and improve features and reliability;
diagnose crashes and technical failures;
prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents;
respond to support and privacy requests; and
comply with law and enforce applicable terms.

list1.title: Where the GDPR, UK GDPR, or similar laws apply, the relevant legal bases may include:
items: performance of a contract or steps requested by you, for App functionality, sharing, support, and purchase processing;
consent, for personalized advertising and other processing where consent is legally required;

legitimate interests, including App improvement, aggregate analytics, diagnostics, service security, abuse prevention, and technical server operation, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights; and
compliance with legal obligations, including legally valid requests and financial, consumer-protection, or security requirements.

sections: Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent for future processing. Withdrawal does not affect processing that was lawful before withdrawal.

list.title: We may disclose or allow processing of information by:
items: Google LLC and its affiliates, including Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, Firebase Remote Config, AdMob, UMP, Google Play, and related platform services;
hosting and infrastructure providers that deliver name images and protect our servers;
applications and recipients you select, when you initiate sharing;
professional advisers, authorities, courts, or other parties where reasonably necessary to comply with law, protect rights and safety, investigate abuse, or establish and defend legal claims; and
a successor or transaction participant in connection with a merger, acquisition, financing, reorganization, or sale of all or part of our business, subject to appropriate safeguards.

sections: We do not sell personal information for money. However, the disclosure of identifiers and activity information for personalized advertising may be treated as a "sale," "sharing," or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Where applicable, you may exercise an opt-out right through the privacy-choice mechanism made available for your region.

list.title: We apply the following retention periods or criteria:
items: locally stored App information remains until you change it, clear the App's storage, or uninstall the App, subject to any platform-controlled backup;
temporary name-card files are deleted after the sharing operation is completed or attempted;
image-delivery access and error logs are retained for no longer than 30 days, except when needed for a specific security investigation or legal obligation;
Firebase Analytics user-level and event-level data is configured for 14 months, with the period reset on new activity;
Firebase Crashlytics data is generally retained for 90 days before deletion begins;
advertising, consent, purchase, Remote Config, platform, security, and fraud-prevention information is retained by Google according to the relevant Google service settings and retention policies; and
support communications are retained according to the criteria described in Section 11.

sections: We may retain irreversibly aggregated or de-identified information where it can no longer reasonably be linked to an individual.

Metamodern Dev and its service providers may process information in countries other than the country where you live. Privacy laws and government-access rules may differ in those countries. Where required, the relevant parties use recognized safeguards or transfer mechanisms provided by applicable law and their contractual arrangements.

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures appropriate to the nature of the information, including data minimization, HTTPS for network communication, limited use of server logs, and access controls for developer services. Locally stored information is also protected by the security mechanisms of your device and operating system.

No storage or transmission method can be guaranteed to be completely secure. You are responsible for maintaining appropriate security for your device, platform account, and any application through which you share a name card.

list.title: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to:
items: obtain confirmation of processing and access personal information;
request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information that we control, where applicable;
request deletion, anonymization, blocking, or restriction;
receive portable information where applicable;
object to certain processing or withdraw consent;
opt out of sale, sharing, targeted advertising, or certain profiling;
receive information about the parties with whom information is disclosed;
appeal a refusal of a privacy request where applicable;
receive equal service and not be discriminated against for exercising a privacy right; and
lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory or regulatory authority in your jurisdiction.

sections: These rights concern personal information about you. They do not apply to the general names database, name meanings, images, or other editorial content supplied with the App.

Residents of Brazil may also have the rights provided by the LGPD, including confirmation, access, correction, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary or unlawfully processed information, portability where regulated, information about sharing and consent, withdrawal of consent, and review of certain decisions based solely on automated processing where applicable.

Most surname and name-selection information is stored only on your device, so we normally cannot access, identify, correct, export, or delete it remotely. You can manage that information inside the App, clear the App's storage, or uninstall the App. Information controlled by Google can also be managed through the applicable Google account, advertising, device, and privacy controls.

To submit a request concerning information controlled by Metamodern Dev, email metamodern.dev@gmail.com. We may request information reasonably necessary to verify and process the request. If we deny a request, you may reply to the decision to appeal where applicable.

The App is intended for users aged 18 and older and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly request or use the surname or local name-selection information of a child through our servers. If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us, contact us so that we can review and, where appropriate, delete it.

The App may open app-store pages, websites, or third-party applications. Third parties operate under their own terms and privacy policies. This Privacy Policy does not govern information that a third party receives directly from you or through its own service.

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in the App, service providers, legal requirements, or our practices. We will publish the revised policy and update the date at the top. Where required by law, we will provide additional notice or request consent before materially different processing begins.
For privacy questions or requests worldwide, contact:
Metamodern Dev, LLC metamodern.dev@gmail.com
